item.title: Reverse-Engineering Flock Cameras

The camera can produce dozens of images of a single passing vehicle and, according to several weeks of recovered logs, generated more than a million images. Its computer-vision software also sometimes isolated bumper stickers and other graphics, including, in one case, an American flag patch on a motorcyclist&#8217;s saddlebag...</p></blockquote>
